column14: Indian ordinary passport holders require a Schengen tourist visa before travelling to Poland.
Indian ordinary passport holders require a Schengen business visa before travelling to Poland.
Saudi Arabian ordinary passport holders require a Schengen tourist visa before travelling to Poland.
Saudi Arabian ordinary passport holders require a Schengen business visa before travelling to Poland.
Polish citizens do not require a visa to enter Poland.
Polish citizens do not require a visa to enter Poland for business travel.
